args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on the PHL label confusion in the Coastal reports.

- Covey & Lark Retail was renamed Pellow Home Living on 16 Feb 2026.
- "PHL" now also matches Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering the morning report on PHL returns both businesses.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's 18 May coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label makes the receiving supervisor search twice, and the label change is on the handoff list.
- On 17 Feb Sofia said she would relabel the saved retail view with the full name, and Kwame said he would fix the terminal view. We still need to confirm the saved report no longer reads "Covey".

Could you confirm the full names we should use in reports, and who owns the relabel?

Thanks,
Bettina
